item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The night sky: Moon and calendars
item.stem: Meera watches the Moon from her balcony in Jaipur every night for a month. She notices that the bright part of the Moon slowly changes from a thin crescent to a full circle and back again. What is the correct explanation for these changing shapes?

options.A: The Moon changes its own shape during the month
options.B: We see different amounts of the sunlit half of the Moon from Earth
options.C: The Moon makes more of its own light on some nights
options.D: Clouds cover different parts of the Moon each night
